title: Kaththi
desc: A fugitive encounters his doppelgänger and plots to steal his identity for a quick escape. However, fate intervenes as he chooses to embrace and fight for his look-alike's mission.

title: Mathu Vadalara 2
desc: Delivery boys Babu and Yesu join a special police team in a bid to fill their pockets. However, they find themselves in trouble when they set out to solve a kidnapping case.

title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Yevadu
desc: Satya gets a different face after he is almost killed, but a new face multiplies his problems. His ordeal begins when he leaves the hospital and has to deal with his lover's murderer.

title: Simhamanti Chinnodu
desc: A young man is assigned to protect the daughter of a powerful landlord whom he admires. Soon, the bodyguard falls in love with an anonymous admirer of his, unaware that she is the landlord's daughter.

title: Hanumanthu
desc: Hanumanthu, a simpleton, goes on a revenge spree after discovering that Krishnamurthy had murdered his father, Hanumanthiah.

title: Nuvva Nena
desc: A lawbreaker, Avinash, falls in love with Dr Nandini who already has a suitor, Anand, who is a patient. Eventually, Avinash and Anand discover that Dr Nandini is in love with someone else.

title: Bichagadu 2
desc: Trouble arises when a poor ex-convict's brain is transplanted into a rich man's body without consent. While he looks for his sister, he must tackle new problems.

title: Raja the Great
desc: Raja, a person with visual impairment, is skilled and sets out on a mission to rescue a girl, Lucky, the pampered daughter of a sincere police officer.

title: Om Bheem Bush
desc: Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.

title: Pushpa: The Rise - Part 1
desc: As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.

title: Hidimbha
desc: In Hyderabad, a series of murders targets young girls. Later, officers Aadhya and Abhay investigate as more victims disappear, soon discovering a common link among them.
